featured_reviews.name: Yogita Karpe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Disappointing Experience – Poor Product Quality

I purchased a pair of Crocs worth ₹6,000 from Capital Mall (Metro Brand). Unfortunately, within just 6 months, the Crocs are completely damaged and not even in a wearable condition.

For a brand like Crocs, I expected durability and quality—especially at this price point. This kind of damage in such a short time is absolutely unacceptable.

When I approached the store for help, I was simply told that nothing can be done because it has been more than 6 months. There was no support, no solution, and no accountability for a clearly defective product.

If a customer is spending ₹6,000, is it unreasonable to expect the product to last longer than 6 months? How is this the customer’s fault?

Extremely disappointed with both product quality and after-sales service. I would strongly advise customers to think twice before purchasing from here.
